unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #524 on accensa/accensa-contracts: XNO as the receipt rail — a feeless per-request block that IS the proof, removing the Merkle-batching workaround the fee created. Quoted their own benchmark ("sub-cent fees make per-request payments viable at all") to argue Nano removes even that constraint. Carries canon 1+2 + extract.paypercall.dev + key-management doc + nanswap + open-research disclosure. Verified published (XNO present, fetched back).
